name: Support ticket routing (hard)
instruction: Classify the customer message into exactly one category: billing, technical, account, or shipping. Reply with the category name only, in lowercase.
rules: Refund and money-back requests are billing, even if the item arrived broken or late. Anything that does not load, crashes, freezes or displays wrongly is technical, even on the invoice or checkout page. Login, password, username, profile and account deletion are account. Delivery, tracking and address changes are shipping.

examples.input: I want my money back for the order that arrived three weeks late.
examples.label: billing

examples.input: The receipt email shows weird symbols instead of the amounts.
examples.label: technical

examples.input: I forgot my username, can you remind me?
examples.label: account

examples.input: Can I change the delivery address after placing my order?
examples.label: shipping

items.input: My order arrived with a cracked screen and I want a refund.
items.label: billing

items.input: The tracking page just shows a blank white screen.
items.label: technical

items.input: I can't log in, so I can't see where my parcel is.
items.label: account

items.input: Please send my parcel to my sister's address instead.
items.label: shipping

items.input: The invoice page shows my amounts cut off and unreadable.
items.label: technical

items.input: The delivery person never showed up, please give me my money back.
items.label: billing

items.input: I reset my password but the reset email never arrives.
items.label: account

items.input: The app crashes whenever I try to update my delivery address.
items.label: technical

items.input: My username has a typo on my profile page, can you fix it?
items.label: account

items.input: My package says delivered but I never got it and I want my money back.
items.label: billing

items.input: I was billed for an item that I cancelled yesterday.
items.label: billing

items.input: Where is my parcel? It is already five days late.
items.label: shipping
